action.objective: Verify e3e4 at full depth, the reserved broad-search suggestion at exact 35.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search over all roots gave e3e4 the top exact score 35, ahead of a2a3/a2a4/b2b3/g2g3 at 34 (upper bounds for the latter). e3e4 advances the center, opens the c1 bishop and supports e4-d5 plans; it is the reserved verification candidate. Single-candidate verification at effective depth 4 with the full 2000-node reserve checks safety, immediate mates and any tactical refutation before committing.
